messages:
Maya: Heads up, nightly CI just started failing on staging — kv-cache integration tests. Failing consistently on the same test. Spinning up a quick war-room, joining bridge in 2.
Eli: On it. Can you paste the failing test name? I can grab logs.
Maya: Test name is tests/integration/test_kvcache_integration.py::test_prefix_eviction
Maya: bridge -> https://redwood.huddle/rooms/abc123 (pins: use #war-room)
oncall-bot: Incident room created: nightly-ci-kvcache-1769001234, pager duty notified.
Sania: I can join in 3m. @Rohan any idea if recent KV PRs could affect eviction timing?
Rohan: Possibly — I pushed a change to eviction heuristics yesterday. I'll join now.
Jen: Quick ask: if we need a hotfix, who can cut a canary build? I can if infra approves.
Eli: grabbing logs:
```
E 03:12:47 eviction.cpp:128 evict_prefix() assert failed: key_count >= expected
stack: 0x7ffd..., kv_shard.cc:212
```
Rohan: that stack looks like the code path I touched. Reproducing locally now.
Maya: Agenda for the war-room: 1) Triage failing assert + immediate mitigations (canary revert or config change) 2) If canary needed, Jen to cut and oncall infra to approve 3) Postmortem owner
Sania: adding to agenda: check if this impacts Dedicated pools vs Hosted. I'm running regression across a Dedicated cluster.
Eli: FYI I toggled eviction_threshold to 0.8 in staging config to see if it avoids the assert. If stable in 10m I'll escalate.
Rohan: Found a repro with my branch. Sending patch to PR now, but if we need immediate mitigation, revert PR #4821.
Jen: infra approved canary, pushing canary tag to staging pipeline when we have explicit thumbs up.
Maya: ok team — if toggle holds for 15m, we can avoid revert. Please post results here and on the bridge. I'll log incident and owner after we stabilize.
Eli: toggle held 10/15m, still passing. :thumbsup:
Sania: Dedicated cluster still failing, looks like a race on shard shutdown. Rohan can you instrument with extra logging? small patch pushed to branch r/shard-log.
Rohan: pushed extra logs and bumped timeout. Attaching diff in PR.
Jen: canary deployed to staging -> see build #nightly-1769001249
oncall-bot: Canary deployment succeeded. Observability alert suppressed for 30m.
Maya: good progress. If Dedicated still fails after Rohan's patch, we'll schedule a deeper postmortem. For now keep bridge open and update thread.
Eli: joining dedicated debug session in bridge now.
Maya: thanks everyone — closing the thread for async updates. Will post incident doc link shortly.
Maya: incident doc -> https://docs.redwood/investigations/nightly-ci-kvcache-1769001234
